From: Alex Peterson <alex@novasystems.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-19T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: platform deep-dive & capacity check

Markus, thanks again for the call this morning — really helpful to understand Redwood's serving model. Quick recap from our side: primary goals are (1) validate latency for our 10k concurrent session pattern, (2) confirm SSO and VPC options, and (3) understand cost implications for steady vs burst traffic.

Would like to schedule a technical deep dive next week. Can you please propose 2x 60-min slots (preferred PST mornings)? We also need to loop in our Security and Procurement teams — I can add them once you share a couple of candidate times.

Notes/asks: 
- Please include a short agenda (45 min demo + 15 min Q&A)
- Any pre-call checklist or evidence you need from our side (network/IP allowlist, SOC2 scope)

Thanks,
Alex Peterson
Director, Data Platform
Nova Systems

Attachments: none in this message

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Alex Peterson <alex@novasystems.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-19T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: platform deep-dive & capacity check

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. Glad that matched up. Two candidate windows (PST):
- Wed 2028-03-21 09:00–10:00
- Thu 2028-03-22 10:30–11:30

Olga (security) and Ben (SE) are looped in to confirm availability and share any prep docs. Proposed agenda inside: 1) brief infra overview (10m), 2) live demo of inference path under load (30–40m), 3) ops/SSO/infra Q&A (15m).

Olga — can you confirm if we should ask Nova for any specific evidence ahead of the call? Ben — will you prepare the capacity test plan and a short list of sample payloads?

I’ll also add a HubSpot meeting link once Alex confirms which slot works (HS record below).

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Date: 2028-03-19T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: platform deep-dive & capacity check

Hi Alex / Markus — I can join either slot; prefer Thu 10:30 if that works for your security folks. Pre-call checklist from security: 
- SOC2 scope confirmation (if available)
- IP ranges for allowlisting (if tests will originate from customer infra)
- Any sensitive data flows (PII/PHI) that require masking for demo tokens

I’ve attached a short "security-evidence-list.pdf" that lists typical items we ask for pre-demo. If Nova could share an SSO diagram (SAML/OIDC endpoints) and any firewall egress constraints, that helps speed things up.

I’ll be on the call to review compliance posture and to capture any follow-up evidence requests.

Thanks,

- A short capacity test plan (we'll test 100/1k/10k concurrent session profiles)
- Sample payloads and tokenization notes
- A small slide: "what good looks like" for latency/99s and cost expectations
